mode.description: Mode of operation: 'auto' (prefer local installation), 'lite' (use remote server only)

shell_prompt_prefix.description: Prefix used in shell mode prompt (e.g., 'cht.sh/go>' becomes '<prefix>/<lang>')

stealth_mode.description: Enable automatic queries on selected text (stealth mode)

hush.description: Suppress the help message on shell mode startup

session_id.description: Unique session identifier; use 'reset' to clear, 'remove' to delete, or empty string to reset

server_url.description: Base URL of the cheat.sh server

standalone_dir.description: Local installation directory when using standalone mode (e.g., ~/.cheat.sh)

clipboard_commands.description: List of clipboard commands for copy operations (e.g., ['pbcopy', 'xclip -selection clipboard'])

default_shell_lang.description: Default language context for shell mode (e.g., 'python', 'go')
